description: Tool to list CustomMetrics on a property. Use when you need to retrieve all custom metrics configured for a given property.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing CustomMetrics on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. Maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token from a previous ListCustomMetrics call for pagination to retrieve the next page of results
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Property identifier in format 'properties/{propertyId}'. Example: 'properties/1234'
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: PropertiesCustommetricsListRequest

name: list_custom_metrics

description.description: Description for the custom metric. Max 150 characters
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Display name shown in Google Analytics UI. Max 82 characters
displayName.title: Display Name

measurementUnit.description: Type of the metric's value. Values: MEASUREMENT_UNIT_UNSPECIFIED, STANDARD, CURRENCY, FEET, MILES, METERS, KILOMETERS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS
measurementUnit.title: Measurement Unit

parameterName.description: Immutable parameter name for this custom metric
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

restrictedMetricType.description: Types of restricted data that this metric contains. Values: RESTRICTED_METRIC_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, COST_DATA, REVENUE_DATA
restrictedMetricType.title: Restricted Metric Type

scope.description: Scope of the custom metric. Values: METRIC_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED, EVENT
scope.title: Scope

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving next page. Omitted if no more results available
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
